description: This file defines a REST controller for user management in a Spring Boot application, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and profile management for users.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: REST controller managing user-related endpoints in the application.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's profile information.

methods.name: getUserById
methods.description: Retrieves user information by their ID, accessible only to admins.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all users, accessible only to admins.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates the details of a user specified by ID.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by ID, accessible only to admins.
